description: WE, THE STUDENTS OF GRADE 4TH PARTICIPATING IN PLANETX SPHEREX CHALLENGE IN NASA SPACE APPS UNDER THE GUIDANCE OF OUR MENTOR KAVYA S. WE HAVE CREATED A WEBSITE FOR YOUNGER CHILDREN TO UNDERSTAND ABOUT OUR PLANETS USING NASA DATA WITH MANY ACTIVITES IN OUR WEBISTE.
summary: Planet X  Sphere X is an interactive space exploration website designed to make learning about our universe more engaging ,informative and accessible. Our platform brings fascinating information about planets ,exoplanets, asteroids and other celestial objects in one place. the website offers detailed information about planets, including their features , composition, atmosphere and unique characteristics . It also includes interactive space missions , where users can  explore space through engaging mission based activities and challenges . Our space bots feature  provides an interactive way for users to learn about space and get answers to their space - related questions . The exoplanet section introduces users to planets beyond our solar system, while the asteroids section provides  insights  into these rocky objects , their properties and their importance in space research . Planet X Sphere X  aims to transform traditional space learning into an exciting , interactive experience  by combining educational content,  , exploration and  interactive technologies. Our vision is to inspire curiosity about the universe, encourage scientific thinking and bring the wonders of space closer to everyone .
